adds.title: Blade: The Series#8
adds.text: In a flashback to Eric's boyhood, a local officer introduces his father to Whistler, who tests the half vampire boy.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tests the boy Eric in a flashback to his childhood.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The half vampire boy Whistler tests in a flashback.
adds.evidence: Sacrifice (episode 8) lists a young Abraham Whistler in flashback alongside young Eric and his father; Wikipedia's cast notes say Officer Flannigan introduced Eric's father to Whistler, who tested the boy.
